Aries.traits: A pioneering leader with kinetic drive and courage
Aries.core_insight: Your fiery Martian core compels you to initiate bold ventures. You thrive when breaking through stagnancy. Patience is your testing ground, but rapid action is your superpower.

Taurus.traits: A steadfast builder of enduring material and spiritual wealth
Taurus.core_insight: Governed by Venus, your power lies in grounding visionary ideas into concrete reality. You possess extraordinary endurance, loyalty, and an instinctive eye for long-term value.

Gemini.traits: An agile communicator and synthesizer of high-dimensional knowledge
Gemini.core_insight: Mercurial dexterity grants you a fast-processing mental framework. You excel at connecting disparate communities and translating complex concepts into actionable dialogue.

Cancer.traits: An intuitive protector with immense emotional and psychic depth
Cancer.core_insight: Your lunar frequency grants uncanny intuitive radar. You sense subterranean motives before others speak. Your strength lies in fierce protective care and emotional resilience.

Leo.traits: A regal visionary radiating creative authority and warmth
Leo.core_insight: Solar majesty defines your energetic matrix. You are meant to hold center stage and inspire collective confidence. Your generosity opens doors that sheer ambition cannot.

Virgo.traits: A meticulous problem-solver turning chaotic systems into flawless order
Virgo.core_insight: Precision is your sacred craft. You see the hidden structural flaws others overlook. Your calling is divine service and elevating standards through practical mastery.

Libra.traits: A harmonic diplomat restoring cosmic equilibrium through justice
Libra.core_insight: You hold the scales of truth and aesthetic grace. Your greatest accomplishments come through synergistic alliances, fair negotiation, and sophisticated cultural balance.

Scorpio.traits: An alchemical catalyst of regeneration and deep psychological truth
Scorpio.core_insight: You navigate crisis with sovereign fearlessness. You transform pain into wisdom and penetrate superficial masks. Your influence is magnetic, subtle, and irreversible.

Sagittarius.traits: A philosophical explorer pursuing broad horizons and universal truth
Sagittarius.core_insight: Jupiterian benevolence bestows boundless optimism. You are built for global journeys, intellectual breakthroughs, and inspiring others with uncompromising idealism.

Capricorn.traits: An immovable mountain of discipline, governance, and legacy
Capricorn.core_insight: Mastery of time is your karmic gift. You peak in maturity. Your steady, pragmatic climb constructs institutions and generational security that outlast transient trends.

Aquarius.traits: A revolutionary visionary reorganizing society for collective evolution
Aquarius.core_insight: Your frequency is set to the future. You reject stifling dogmas in favor of technological, scientific, and humanitarian liberation. Your genius lies in originality.

Pisces.traits: A mystical sage dissolving boundaries between spirit and reality
Pisces.core_insight: As the oceanic culmination of the zodiac, your empathy is universal. You possess artistic and spiritual gifts that heal collective wounds when you protect your boundaries.
